description: List APM's phase-1 procurement categories (token_risk, wallet_onchain, web_search) and how many verified suppliers are registered/active in each. Free. This tool is free and never executes a purchase. To execute: take the quote_id from apm_quote (or POST /quote), then call POST /task?quote=<quote_id> and pay customer_price in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402.
name: apm_categories
